Evidence and physics fidelity

Search scene: feet-only (Playground scene_mjx_feetonly_flat_terrain: only the four foot spheres collide with the floor, so a fallen trunk can sink through it). Independent replay: every certified minimal counterexample was re-run on up to 8 seeds in C MuJoCo on Playground's scene_mjx_fullcollisions_flat_terrain.xml, a different contact geometry from the search scene. 0 of 1 families reproduced; 1 did not clear the bar (1 of those inconclusive at this seed budget) (59 s CPU). Failure surrogate fit: not shown: 192 labeled worlds (179 fail / 13 pass); a fit number needs >= 200 worlds and >= 20 of the rarer class to say anything about the failure boundary.

Overall failure rate among search-evaluated worlds: 0.932 (95% CI 0.888–0.960) over 192 physically valid evaluated envs. These worlds were chosen by the search, an adversarial process that concentrates on failures, so this is NOT a deployment failure probability; see the operational risk section when present.

Expected-value risk = probability × severity (the standard risk metric). This does NOT guarantee a rare catastrophic family outranks a common mild one — see the severity view below.
